statements.t: As anticipated, our year-over-year revenue growth moderated in the third quarter compared to the first half of 2026, reflecting in part the timing of our entry into a competitive non-tender market in Europe.
With that market launch now behind us, we anticipate revenue growth to reaccelerate in the fourth quarter for a strong finish to the year.

We are encouraged by our geographic expansion, specialty pharmacy partnerships, and pipeline advancements and plan to continue investing resources in our long-term growth strategy as we move forward.”
